question: Fill in the blanks with appropriate words: (a) Leave should not ordinarily be denied during the last __________ years of service. (b) Leave may not be granted to a Government Servant under __________ (c) Wilful absence from duty after expiry of leave renders a Govt. Servant liable to __________. (d) The authority competent to grant leave may commute retrospectively periods of absence without leave into __________.

Calculate the amount of Earned Leave encashment payable to a Government Servant having the following particulars: Balance of Earned Leave as on 01.01.2016: 200 days, Date of retirement: 31.12.2018 (AN), Pay on the date of retirement: Rs. 56,100, Rate of Dearness Allowance: 9% of Basic pay, Availed Hospital leave for 50 days w.e.f 12.07.2017
To whom can compulsory retirement pension be granted. Mention the rates admissible for such pension.
Define any 3 (three) of the following in relation to CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972: (a) Allottee (b) Minor (c) Dearness Relief (d) Head of Department (e) Pension Disbursing Authority

Calculate the qualifying service rendered by Mr Thanga to be taken into account for calculation of a provisional pension from his service particulars given below: Date of birth: 01.03.1953, Date of appointment on probation: 03.08.1973, Date of confirmation: 20.10.1976, Dies non: 11.02.1985 – 20.03.1985, Placed under suspension: 21.06.2010, Died while under suspension: 15.11.2010
To whom does CCS(Pension) Rules, 1972 apply? Mention four categories of Government Servants to whom these rules shall not apply.
Calculate the period commencing on 20th January, 2016 and ending with 15th December, 2018 and expressed in terms of year, month and days.
What is the procedure to be adopted if a suspended official is due to retire from service on superannuation?
Under what conditions can Commuted leave be granted to Government Servants?
How does the following affect pension? (a) Periods of suspension (b) Past service on reinstatement
What are the special kinds of leave other than study leave that can be availed of by a Government Servant?
What is the procedure to be followed for relinquishment of charge of office in the case of a retiring Govt. Servant when the day on which he is due to retire happens to be a closed holiday?

Calculate Earned Leave at the credit of Pu Mawia from the particulars given below: Earned leave at credit on 01.01.2015: 150 days, Availed Earned leave (1) for 30 days from 02.03.2015 (2) for 20 days from 10.10.2016, Availed Child Care Leave for 120 days from 15.02.2017, Find out Earned leave credit on 01.01.2018
How will you regulate unavailed Joining Time in relation to Earned Leave credit?

Calculate proportionate pension of Mr A from the table given below: Qualifying Service: 30 years, Last Emoluments: Rs 37,000, Average Emoluments: Rs 36,500, Date of retirement: 31.12.2018 (AN), Rate of Dearness allowance: 9% of amount of pension (For the purpose of Dearness Relief)
Define any three of the following: (a) Competent Authority to sanction special disability leave (b) Leave not due (c) Maximum amount of Study Leave (d) Vacation Department

Give your answer to the following questions: (a) Can regular leave be granted to cover transit period in the case of own request transfer? (b) When will joining time commence if relinquishment of charge is made in the forenoon? (c) From where shall joining time be calculated? (d) What number of days can be granted by Head of Department for extension of joining time? (e) What is the joining time admissible when the transfer necessarily involves continuous travel by road for more than 200 km?
